speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your flank pain and confirm if you are experiencing any changes in your urinary habits, such as frequency or burning? I also need to know which antibiotic you were prescribed for your sinusitis and for how long.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any blood in your urine? Please also tell me exactly which antibiotic you took for your sinusitis and for how many days.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you currently have any pain or burning when you urinate, or have you noticed any blood in your urine? I also need to know if you have experienced any nausea, vomiting, or chills alongside your fever.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of a rash with amoxicillin followed by fever and flank pain after switching to cephalexin, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Serum Creatinine.
